$schema: Real recordings kept for swing-detection modelling. Each entry's realSwingsPerSet is ground truth from the person who recorded it, not something derivable from the FIT file - add it by hand whenever a new fixture is added.

fixtures.description: 4 work sets: 5 singles, 5 singles, 10 doubles, 10 doubles.
fixtures.notes: First real 25Hz raw-magnitude recording. Predates the gyro-capture work entirely - no gyro_x/y/z fields, no gyro_peak. Singles came in exact on-device; doubles were undercounted.

fixtures.description: 4 work sets: 5 singles, 5 singles, 10 doubles, 10 doubles.
fixtures.notes: First recording with per-axis gyro capture (gyro_x/y/z) and raw accel magnitude together. Opposite failure pattern from recA: singles badly undercounted, doubles closer. Set 2's true count includes ~2 extra events from picking the mace up / putting it down at the set boundary (user-confirmed real behaviour, not a detection bug) - accepted as counting toward the total for now, so onDeviceDetectedPerSet is graded against realSwingsPerSet as given, not adjusted for that.

fixtures.description: 2 long work sets of 60 two-handed 10-to-2 swings each.
fixtures.notes: User-confirmed exact 60/60 ground truth. The accelerometer-only on-device counter captured only 28-30%, making this the primary slow-heavy-mace undercount fixture for gyro and sensor-fusion experiments.
